summary: Tested doctor + partner social media links and presentation video upload feature for keneyakafisa. Backend 11/11 pytest tests pass. Frontend doctor & partner dashboards work and persist values; public doctor profile shows social badges + uploaded video. All previously fixed bugs (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY env, lazy storage init, include_router order) are now confirmed resolved.
passed_tests: Backend PUT /api/profile/social-links saves tiktok/facebook/instagram/video_url for doctor and returns the profile (no _id) with the new values
Backend PUT /api/profile/social-links saves the same fields for partner
Backend POST /api/upload/video by doctor returns {success:true, video_url:'/api/media/keneyakafisa/videos/...'} and persists presentation_video on doctor_profiles
Backend POST /api/upload/video by partner persists presentation_video on partner_profiles
Backend POST /api/upload/video returns 400 for non-video content-type
Backend GET /api/media/{path} streams the uploaded video back with content-type video/*
Backend GET /api/doctors/{doctor_id} returns tiktok_url, facebook_url, instagram_url, video_url AND presentation_video fields
Backend GET /api/partner/profile (auth) returns the same fields for the logged-in partner

Frontend /doctor/dashboard: 'Réseaux sociaux & Vidéo' card present with data-testids tiktok-input/facebook-input/instagram-input/video-url-input/save-social-btn/video-upload-input. Save persists across reload. Upload of small MP4 makes presentation-video element appear

Frontend /partner/dashboard: partner-tiktok-input/partner-facebook-input/partner-instagram-input/partner-video-url-input/partner-save-social-btn/partner-video-upload-input present. Save persists across reload

Frontend /doctor/:doctorId (public): doctor-social-links badges (tiktok/facebook/instagram links), doctor-presentation-video block and doctor-uploaded-video <video> element rendered (uploaded video takes precedence over external video_url, which is the expected branch)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2603 lines — should be modularised (routers/{auth,doctor,partner,media}.py). Not blocking but increasingly hard to maintain.
/api/profile/social-links accepts a raw dict; should use a Pydantic model so empty body / wrong types return 422 instead of silently no-op.

/api/upload/video does not check that the doctor_profiles / partner_profiles document actually exists; update_one with no match silently succeeds. Consider using upsert=False with a matched_count check and returning 404.
Storage URLs are stored as '/api/media/keneyakafisa/videos/<user_id>/<uuid>.<ext>'. The path is publicly fetchable without auth — fine for presentation videos but worth flagging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all expected data-testids present, persistence + upload verified, public profile shows assets)

test_credentials: Tests create their own throwaway doctor / partner / patient via /api/auth/register with timestamped emails (testflow_*@test.com, uitest_*@test.com), password TestPass123!. Admin (MADJIB / 48851132kl) was NOT used.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway accounts left in DB: testflow_doctor_<ts>@test.com, testflow_partner_<ts>@test.com, testflow_patient_<ts>@test.com, uitest_doctor_<ts>@test.com, uitest_partner_<ts>@test.com. Each has small (~1 KB) MP4 file in object storage under keneyakafisa/videos/<user_id>/. Safe to delete via admin /admin/users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is complete. Backend test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_social_and_video.py and can be re-run via `pytest backend/tests/test_social_and_video.py -v`. The MP4 used in tests is a synthetic 1 KB ftyp box (see _minimal_mp4_bytes()); backend only validates content-type + size, so this is enough. Doctor-public-profile route is /doctor/:doctorId where doctorId is doctor_profiles.id (NOT user_id) — found via /api/doctors/search.
